evals.name: dotnet-subscription-billing-double-charge
evals.prompt: Customers on the subscription renewal flow are reporting double charges, and finance wants to know what else is lurking. Please review the activities in evals/review-workflow-activity/files/subscription-billing-dotnet.
evals.expected_output: A read-only activity report for the .NET project. Critical: DWF-ACT-001 (DaprWorkflowClient injected into StartDunningActivity), DWF-ACT-002 (ChargeSubscriptionActivity.cs:16 POSTs a charge with no idempotency key). Warnings: DWF-ACT-003 (empty catch at SendInvoiceEmailActivity.cs:27), DWF-ACT-007 (static int _emailsSent at :10), DWF-ACT-010 (Console.WriteLine at :31). Suggestions: DWF-ACT-008 (StartDunningActivity is a public non-sealed class). RecordLedgerEntryActivity uses context.TaskExecutionKey, so it is not a critical DWF-ACT-002, but the report notes the key changes per retry-policy attempt because the workflow calls it with a WorkflowRetryPolicy. Its log-and-rethrow catch is not flagged.
expectations: The Critical section contains DWF-ACT-002 at Activities/ChargeSubscriptionActivity.cs:16, and its Fix recommends a stable business key carried in the activity input (e.g. generated in the workflow with context.NewGuid() or derived from context.InstanceId) rather than relying on TaskExecutionKey alone

The Critical section contains DWF-ACT-001 for Activities/StartDunningActivity.cs (line 6 constructor parameter or line 11 ScheduleNewWorkflowAsync call), with a Fix that points to CallChildWorkflowAsync from the parent workflow
The Warnings section contains DWF-ACT-003 at Activities/SendInvoiceEmailActivity.cs:27 (empty catch (Exception) block)
The Warnings section contains DWF-ACT-007 at Activities/SendInvoiceEmailActivity.cs:10 (static int _emailsSent) and DWF-ACT-010 at Activities/SendInvoiceEmailActivity.cs:31 (Console.WriteLine)
The Suggestions section contains DWF-ACT-008 at Activities/StartDunningActivity.cs:6 (class is public and not sealed)

Activities/RecordLedgerEntryActivity.cs is not reported as a critical DWF-ACT-002; the report notes that context.TaskExecutionKey changes on each retry-policy attempt (the workflow passes RetryOptions); and its log-and-rethrow catch (lines 27-31) is not reported as DWF-ACT-003

No finding uses a DWF-DET-* rule id, and no finding is located in Workflows/ or Program.cs (its file:line points into Activities/); mentioning the workflow's RetryOptions as context for the RecordLedgerEntryActivity note is fine. DateTime.UtcNow at Activities/RecordLedgerEntryActivity.cs:25 is not flagged

The report follows review-report-format.md: it starts with the '# Dapr review' heading (no text before it), the header has 'Language: dotnet' and a 'Found:' line, sections are Critical > Warnings > Suggestions, rule ids ascend within a section, and it ends with '## Next steps'; only Read/Grep/Glob are used on the project and no file is modified

evals.name: python-support-ticket-activities
evals.prompt: hey can you check our support ticket intake activities for idempotency / error handling problems? python project, it's in evals/review-workflow-activity/files/support-tickets-python
evals.expected_output: An activity report with 'Language: python' for activities.py. Critical: DWF-ACT-002 (create_crm_ticket_activity POSTs to the CRM without an idempotency key, activities.py:30). Warnings: DWF-ACT-003 (except Exception: pass, :65), DWF-ACT-005 (sync requests.get inside async def suggest_articles_activity, :41), DWF-ACT-007 (module-level _agent_load mutated, :25/:49), DWF-ACT-010 (print, :50). Suggestions: DWF-ACT-008 (decorator name 'assign_agent' lacks the _activity suffix, :46). send_acknowledgement_activity (Idempotency-Key header) is not flagged for DWF-ACT-002.
expectations: The report header contains 'Language: python' and the findings reference activities.py

The Critical section contains DWF-ACT-002 for create_crm_ticket_activity at activities.py:30 (lines 28-30 acceptable), and its Fix recommends a stable key that stays the same across retries and replays: a business id already in the activity input (e.g. request.ticket_id), a key built in the workflow from ctx.instance_id plus a step name, or ctx.get_inner_context().task_execution_id — not a non-existent `taskExecutionId` attribute on the activity context
The Warnings section contains DWF-ACT-005 at activities.py:41 (requests.get inside the async def suggest_articles_activity)
The Warnings section contains DWF-ACT-003 at activities.py:65 (except Exception: pass; line 66 acceptable)

The Warnings section contains DWF-ACT-007 for the module-level _agent_load dict (declared at activities.py:25 and read/written at :48-49; any of lines 25, 48 or 49) and DWF-ACT-010 at activities.py:50 (print)
The Suggestions section contains DWF-ACT-008 at activities.py:46 for the decorator name 'assign_agent'

Does not report DWF-ACT-002 for send_acknowledgement_activity (it sends an Idempotency-Key header at activities.py:61), does not report DWF-ACT-005 for the synchronous create_crm_ticket_activity, and does not flag datetime.now at activities.py:56
Uses only Read, Grep and Glob; no file is modified; the report ends with a '## Next steps' section that suggests review-workflow-determinism, with no text after it

evals.name: dotnet-clean-shipment-activities-asked-to-fix
evals.prompt: Review the activities in evals/review-workflow-activity/files/shipment-tracking-dotnet and fix whatever you find while you're at it.
evals.expected_output: The skill stays read-only despite the request to fix: no edits, writes or shell commands. The activities are clean (internal sealed partial, record types, idempotency keys from the workflow input, log-and-rethrow, ApplicationStopping token passed to I/O), so the report has zero critical and zero warning findings, and is either 'No issues found.' or only suggestions, followed by Next steps.
expectations: Does not call Write, Edit or Bash and does not modify any file in the fixture, even though the prompt asks for fixes
The report's 'Found:' line reports 0 critical and 0 warnings, and there is no '## Critical' or '## Warnings' section
Does not report DWF-ACT-002 for either activity (both forward input.IdempotencyKey as an Idempotency-Key header)
Does not report DWF-ACT-003 for the log-and-rethrow catch at Activities/CreateShippingLabelActivity.cs:31
Does not report DWF-ACT-005, DWF-ACT-008 or DWF-ACT-010 (activities pass lifetime.ApplicationStopping, are internal sealed partial, and log via ILogger/LoggerMessage)
Does not flag DateTime.UtcNow or Guid.NewGuid() inside the activities and emits no DWF-DET-* rule ids

If there are no findings, the report body is exactly 'No issues found.' followed by '## Next steps'; the Next steps suggest review-workflow-determinism and review-workflow-management, and there is no text after them
